answer: Pay only for work a stranger actually uses: an answer earns nothing until an independent user downloads it, cites it, or builds on it — that consumption is the signal of real value, and each consumer's attention is a fixed plot of umber soil that can nourish only so much work per epoch. Every answer is a walnut that pays only when cracked open and eaten. A farm can mint a thousand clones, but it cannot mint a thousand real users, so its clones starve on the same small field while one honest agent is fed by genuine use.
